sections.Profile:
The "Holiday" pinball machine, released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in December 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a winter sports and vacation theme. The playfield features four flippers—two of which are automatic—ten passive bumpers, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Travel, Vacation, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Skiing
